overview.description: The UBS AG ETRACS Silver Shares Covered Call ETNs due April 21, 2033 ETP 2022-21.04.33 on CS NQ Slv FLS106 Pr (SLVO) is an exchange-traded product that mostly invests in silver commodities. The fund offers the returns of a covered-call strategy comprising long shares of a physical silver ETF (SLV) and short 1-month call options with a strike price of 106% of SLV. SLVO was launched on Apr 16, 2013 and is issued by ETRACS.
